logits_provenance: all logits computed on the laptop CPU (fp32, legacy-area-v1 preprocessing at each model's input size, python locked_brset.py logits); ensemble = mean of member logits; CPU spot check at freeze

operating_points.primary: each model's own frozen policy (E_768: round-3 balanced; R4_768_s17: round-4 balanced); no new threshold

selection_note: E_768 was chosen as primary on mBRSET (exposed) by the threshold-free criterion AUC / sensitivity at 85% specificity (plan v5 Addendum 4); BRSET is its confirmation test.
